identification.name: Batman: Black & White — Harley Quinn by Lee Bermejo
identification.editionEvidence: Owner's underside photo reads 0475 of 5200, Manufactured in China, TM & copyright DC Comics, and (s16).
identification.visualMatch: Monochrome pigtails, black mask, ruff, lace-up corset, Puddin' waist marking, shoulder-rested mallet, boots and oval Batman-logo base match the Lee Bermejo statue.
identification.measurementNote: Height is the published approximate product height. Retailer packaging dimensions and listed weight were not substituted for statue measurements.
identification.releaseDateNote: The DC solicitation advertised August 2016. Contemporary September 14 release lists include this specific statue, corroborated by My Anime Shelf. The underside s16 is a year marking, not an exact release date.

ownership.costBasisAssumption: Owner explicitly stated Harley is 25 and Huntress is 35. Harley item and total paid are both recorded at $25; no separate tax or shipping charges were supplied. Huntress remains at $35.
ownership.condition: Displayed in owner's photo with mallet and base. A full condition inspection and packaging check were not supplied.

photos.description: Full front view on oval Batman-logo base; collection display photo.
Underside showing edition #0475 of 5200, origin and DC Comics (s16) markings.

market.liquidityBasis: Provisional collection category assumption; actual time to sale has not been measured.
market.reason: Low confidence. Used display-piece estimate, assuming intact mallet and base; box unconfirmed. Modeled $35 low / $50 mid / $75 high before seller fees, shipping and tax. Exact Bermejo eBay product asks $75-$80 boxed; indexed Poshmark sold page shows $50 but direct verification failed. Estimates are asking-led, not verified sold comparables.

observations.note: Matching Bermejo product summary in eBay's category page; not an individual completed transaction. Current results and shipping may change.
Matching product's catalog summary; not used as a verified sale or as the source of manufacturer MSRP.

Search index displayed Sold and $50 for the exact titled statue, but the direct listing returned 404. Condition, actual transaction date, final payment and current availability could not be verified; excluded from market valuation.
Exact statue #2109/5200. Closed listing explicitly states it has not been sold; not a sale comparable.

market.valuationBasis: Used US private resale, intact; packaging unconfirmed; excludes transaction costs
